text:
[IRET.12.4] **Dependency table.** An `oa` map ([IRET.28])
keyed by the justifying activation's creation timetag, which
no two activations share. Each value holds the activation's
rule name and the ids of the logical facts it justifies: up to
16 inline, overflow in a heap list.

---

idris.name: Iret_12_4__run_kind
idris.note: Every row's rule exists, and a live fact with the row's target id has a kind that rule emits. A run invariant, what makes a retracted fact's kind one of its row's rule.

idris.name: iret_12_4__reach_engine_justifs
idris.note: Executed: the reach run's final table, as two mutually supporting justifications.

idris.name: Iret_12_4__row
idris.note: One dependency: the activation as its (rule ordinal, token identity) pair [IRET.11] and the logical fact id it justifies -- one entry of the clause's `activation_id -> fact_id_list` map, flattened.

idris.name: Iret_12_4__table
idris.note: The dependency table as a list of rows; the hash map and inline array are representation.

idris.name: iret_12_4__justifs
idris.note: The table read as Rete/Refcount.idr's justifications: an activation's antecedents are the facts its token binds, its target the fact it justified. The bridge from the engine to the fixpoint theorems.

idris.name: Ltim_2_5_1__emitted
idris.note: What a row of the dependency table can target: a kind some rule emits.

idris.name: Ltim_2_5_1__rows_emitted
idris.note: THE DEPENDENCY TABLE'S INVARIANT under the frame: every row's target, read as a live fact, is of an emitted kind.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__rows_emitted_append
idris.note: A fresh fact appended is no row's target, so the table's invariant holds over the grown memory.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__rows_emitted_record
idris.note: A row appended for a live fact of an emitted kind keeps the table's invariant.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__rows_emitted_sub
idris.note: A sub-table over a sub-memory keeps the invariant.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__fired_row
idris.note: The dependency table after one logical emit: one row, its target the emitted fact. Computed.

idris.name: Iret_12__net_state
idris.note: The dependency table beside the network engine: a row per activation and the logical fact it justifies.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__transfer_tms
idris.note: After any history the network's dependency table is FireLoopTms's.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__lapse_rows
idris.note: The dependency table at the fixture as a literal: one row, (rule 0, token identity [1], target 2). Computed.

idris.name: Iret_12_4__run_kind_s
idris.note: The kinds of the rows' targets, of a state.

idris.name: iret_12_4__phase_kind
idris.note: One cascade phase keeps the target kinds: it only removes facts.

idris.name: iret_12_4__phase_n_kind
idris.note: And so does any number of phases, alongside the cascade invariant.

idris.name: iret_12_4__justif_of_row
idris.note: A row of the table is a justification.

idris.name: iret_12_4__row_justif
idris.note: A justification read off the table is a row's.

idris.name: iret_12_4__target_of
idris.note: A row's target is among the table's targets.

idris.name: Iret_12_4__row_facts
idris.note: What a row's activation identity stands for: facts with the row's ids that match the row's rule (kinds in pattern order, guard passed), and such that a live id of theirs is theirs.

idris.name: iret_12_4__facts_live
idris.note: A row's facts are all live when the row's ids are all live, by the row's reading.

idris.name: iret_12_4__id_live
idris.note: And conversely.

idris.name: iret_12_4__live_id
idris.note: An id live in working memory belongs to some live fact.

idris.name: iret_12_4__row_facts_retract
idris.note: A row's reading survives a retraction: a fact of it live afterwards is the same fact, by uniqueness of ids.

idris.name: iret_12_4__targets
idris.note: The targets of a table.

idris.name: iret_12_4__row_facts_keeps
idris.note: A row's reading survives a change that keeps the facts of surviving ids and adds only facts with ids outside the row.
